seo.shortDescription: What Canada, Mexico, the EU, China, Japan and other markets charge on U.S. machinery, engines, pumps and computers, by market and product, with each market's conformity rules.
keywords: China tariff on US farm machinery

intro: 5 of the 9 largest markets charge nothing on qualifying U.S. machinery: Mexico (USMCA), the EU (since July 1, 2026), and the partners with free-trade agreements. Two stand out: Canada, which since September 8, 2026 surtaxes about 50 machinery tariff items (air conditioners, refrigerators, washers, lifting equipment, parts) even when they qualify under CUSMA, and China, which adds a 10% extra duty to its MFN rates and a further 10% on agricultural machinery. What usually decides access is conformity approval — CE marking in the EU, CCC in China, PSE in Japan — and, for machine tools, chip-making equipment and some pumps and valves, U.S. export controls (see Export rules).
valueBasis: FOB value of U.S. exports, as reported by the United States to UN Comtrade.

assumptions: MFN rates are the World Bank/UNCTAD WITS (TRAINS) simple-average applied rates for one representative six-digit subheading per heading — the subheading with the largest 2025 U.S. exports in that heading — for the most recent year WITS holds (2019–2023). National 8–10-digit lines can differ; 'Not confirmed' means WITS has no observation for the line.
Free-trade-agreement rates (USMCA, KORUS, Australia, Singapore and others) apply to qualifying U.S.-origin goods; the normal-rate column shows each market's MFN rate for goods that do not qualify.
For the EU, Regulation (EU) 2026/1455 zeroes out Chapter 84 from July 1, 2026 to December 31, 2029; the normal-rate column shows the rate the EU charged before then.

China's cells add the 10% extra duty on all U.S. goods to its MFN rate, and a further 10% where the heading contains lines of Annex 2 of Announcement 2025 No. 1 (agricultural machinery). China's 2019 counter-tariffs on U.S. goods, valid unless a line is covered by an exclusion until December 31, 2026, are not added because exclusions are granted line by line.
Canada's cells list the tariff items of the September 8, 2026 surtax order (SOR/2026-186, Schedules 1 to 3) found in each heading; only the listed lines pay, and the surtax has no CUSMA exemption.
Taiwan and India show MFN rates: the U.S.–Taiwan agreement (signed February 2026) and the U.S.–India framework have not been implemented as far as we found.
